note: Hand-authored teaching boards (SPEC §2): World 1 levels 1-3 and the first level of Worlds 2-4. The bake solver-verifies each and puts it at the front of its world.

levels.name: One Wall
levels.teaches: Tap the mason, tap the wall. One break reaches the keep.

levels.name: Outside In
levels.teaches: The timber is sealed inside the stone. Break the outer wall first, then the inner one opens to you.

levels.name: The Wrong Wall
levels.teaches: One mason. Spend it on the outer stone and the inner stone is out of reach forever. The axemen go first.

levels.name: Goats and a Chest
levels.teaches: Goats eat hedge. Open the garden and the chest inside hands you a mason for the keep.

levels.name: The Frozen Moat
levels.teaches: Nobody crosses the moat. Torchbearers melt the ice bridge, then the masons have a way in.

levels.name: Iron and a Lever
levels.teaches: No crew can break iron. Reach the lever and it swings the iron door open for you.
